slides.title: OpenDefence Standard Model
slides.html:
• There are many ways to use TAK
  • We offer a thought usage model that aims to deliver value without complexity.

slides.title: Overview - Fighter Sends
slides.html:
1. GeoChat using COMMAND, RECON, BLUFOR and COMMON Channels
  2. If applicable, Send recon observations to OBSERVATIONS Feed

slides.title: Overview - Fighter Gets
slides.html:
1. Receive the CP-produced RECON Feed to get what we know of the AO
  2. Receive Mission PLAN Feeds for marching routes, patrol routes, geofence alerts...
  3. Receive the BLUFOR Feed with eg. approach routes to friendly positions

slides.title: Overview - Leaders & CP Receive
slides.html:
1. Reports from GeoChat COMMAND, RECON, BLUFOR and COMMON Channels
  2. Receive SHARE & OBSERVATION Feed posts to help building the RECON Feed
  3. Plans & feeds & chat from the upper echelons

slides.title: Overview - Leaders & CP Send
slides.html:
1. Order & gain information using the Geochat channels
  2. Build RECON feed for managed picture of our knowledge of the AO
  3. Create PLAN feeds to describe operations in an area
  4. Send your unit's approach routes & important activities to the BLUFOR feed
